changelog:
Initial release of lita-sales-coach: a conversational skill for altruistic sales mindset coaching.

- Supports sales scenarios including scripting, persuasive communication, objection handling, mindset shifts, reporting, trust governance, and resilience.
- Built around the Nonviolent Communication (NVC) framework and a four-layer capability model (philosophy, expression, thinking, communication, adversity).
- Automatically identifies user intent and routes requests to the most relevant guidance and frameworks.
- Features an audit mode to score and improve the "altruistic degree" of existing sales scripts, with actionable feedback.
- Provides tailored sample scripts and transformation logic for finance (insurance, banking, etc.) and software/AI product contexts.
- Emphasizes practical, actionable output—always offering specific scripts or steps rather than generic motivation.
summary: 利他销售思维教练（Altruistic Sales Mindset Coach）。当用户需要销售话术、客户沟通文案、说服谈判、利他表达改写、销冠思维转换、丢单/被拒复盘、向上或客户汇报（信任治理）、抗挫反弹（逆商）时使用，尤其适配金融场景（保险、银行理财、信用卡、贷款、信托）与软件/AI 产品销售（ERP、SaaS、AI 产品）。This skill should be used when the user asks for 销售话术、利他表达、客户沟通、说服/谈判、销冠思维、拒绝处理、销售复盘、向上汇报、信任治理、逆商/抗挫、非暴力沟通/NVC、保险/理财/信用卡/贷款/信托话术、ERP/软件/AI 产品销售，或任何"怎么让对方更容易做出适合自己的选择"的沟通教练场景。覆盖哲学底盘（非暴力沟通 NVC 四要素）+ 四层框架（表达层利他话术7原则+万能公式、思维层销冠夸人技术+6大思维转换+自测、沟通层 GPS-R 信任治理、抗挫层逆商CORE），并附金融/软件/AI 场景改写示例库（含合规护栏）；具备客户意图自动识别与路由能力——先识别客户真实意图与 NVC 底层需要，再自动选定最佳框架作答；并支持对现有话术做利他度审计与打分——定位不利他处、六维打分、给利他指数与修改意见、输出更新后话术。
